reactor_type: low pressure OMVPE system equipped with a tilted horizontal susceptor and separated group II and VI flows
evidence: ZnEt2 and H2Se were used as the main element precursors, though ZnSe could be grown using TMSAZ as the only source for Zn. Typically, the growth was performed at 80 Torr pressure, 5 slrn total flow rate, H2Se at 10 .2 mole fraction, ZnEt2 at 10 -4 mole fraction, and in the temperature range of 250 to 450 ~ C.
